The Butcher would speak of 'the blood of innocents,' and his dark master, 'Kirtonos.' Of how he must appease his master.$B$BFinally, the beast was done with his experiments. We had been drained of all life. Our spirits shattered. The sweet embrace of death was upon us and we welcomed it with open arms. But in his infinite cruelty, the Butcher revived us from death's door.$B$BWe were to be kept alive and thrown to his ravenous ghouls. He laughed as he watched the fiends devour our flesh.
Say hello to my little friends!
Mortals are...
The Night Watch alone cannot protect us forever.  We need the backing of the Stormwind Army.
Don't worry, I'll find a good home for ya.
Something is wrong with the Highlord. Do something!
%s begins countdown.
My son could design a faster car than that clunky goblin junk heap!
The gate is in sight! We're going to make it! But first, I need to take a breather.

For Darrowshire!

You seek Grol'dar and the Darkfire Enclave?  Find them in the underground cavern called the Cleft of Shadow.  There are two tunnels leading down into that cave, one just south of the Valley of Wisdom and the other from The Drag.
Eh, well you've made it this far... go see Lavinia Crowe by the other bookshelf there. If you don't mess things up with her, maybe you can learn some more.
The orders are given!  Move out, and show them what we're made of!
Ooo, so strong!  Happy Hallow's End, $n!

In the northern part of Darkshore runs the Cliffspring River, flowing down from the lands now known as Felwood.  As the river flows out and empties out into the Mist's Edge, travel north to where the deepest parts of the ocean begin.  A stone formation that some call the Stone Claw due to its shape is where you may find what you seek.$B$BBe warned - threshers gather by the Stone Claw, and will attack those who trespass on their territory.
This is disturbing. Please continue.
A thousand years ago, the immortal elves, demigods of the forest and dragons fought against the Legion on the slopes of Hyjal.
Get out of here!
Found something... I think.
Ha! Now your death is ensured!

I don't care to hear it, $n. Nope, no way are you going to be let into the Searing Gorge. Impossible. Not going to happen. How many times do I have to tell you - I can't let you in! Do you not speak common? Are you an orc in disguise? N-O. NO!$B$BIf I let you in, then I have to let everybody in. Pretty soon your close friends will want in, then their distant relatives, then their friends, and so on and so forth. The last time that happened... well, we won't talk about the last time it happened.
You are no match for the Blackrock Orcs!

As acting Taskmaster of this here compound, it is my duty to make sure that there is a certain level of tedium involved with all forms of business, work, rest, and relaxation that may take place here.$B$BIf you find anything that you are asked to do to be too easy and hassle free, report to me immediately.
$n! How have ye been $g lad : lass;? Show me what ye've learned since I saw ye last, we'll see if there's anything new I can teach ye.
What do you want, Komak?
Death and Praise for the Lich King!
What the... what are those things crawling at us?  We... we have incoming!

Looks like the last of the goods we've collected are shipping out to Silithus over the next $2113w days. And once that's done, someone will have to come along and ring the gong on the Scarab Dais, outside of Ahn'Qiraj, to open the gates. That's when our bandages will come in handy.

The night elf army was pushed back through Un'Goro, to the borders of the Tanaris desert. Something in Un'Goro prevented the Qiraji from being able to take the land. I do not quite understand this word but I believe it to mean 'God Lands.' It is stated that they could not 'take the God Lands.'
The Sons of Thaurissan shall watch you perish in the Ring of the Law!
Today, you will meet your ancestors!
